about.title: Divine Heritage
about.p1: The Sri Kalabhairava Swamy Temple in Settikere is a beacon of spiritual significance in the Tumkur district. Dedicated to Lord Kalabhairava, a fierce manifestation of Lord Shiva, the temple attracts devotees from all over Karnataka.
about.p2: Experience peace, devotion, and architectural beauty as you step into the sacred premises. The temple is especially vibrant during Kalashtami and special Saturday poojas.
about.p3: The architecture of the temple reflects the profound heritage of the region, featuring intricate carvings and a serene atmosphere that instantly uplifts the soul. It stands not merely as a place of worship, but as a timeless monument of faith, community, and spiritual awakening.
